justification: Fixes issue #753: the Intelligence Brief 'Data sources' footer rendered a static union — it listed sources cited by null-valued DataFields (pipelines that did not run or returned nothing for the address, e.g. 'Plotdetect Dcp' on a non-onboarded council and 'Satellite imagery + structure detection' with no detection run) and rendered duplicate rows when two internal slugs map to the same real-world label ('NSW Planning Portal — Protection layers' twice). Frontend-only display logic; no backend, model or DB change, so Standard not Critical.

pre_impl.existing_data: No stored data changes shape — the collector walks the already-streamed section events on the client; the DataField contract (value/source/as_at/confidence) is untouched and the backend emits exactly what it did before.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The old walker counted ANY object carrying a source string; the new gate requires a value key with a non-null value, so objects like climate manifest sources_unavailable entries ({source, reason}) no longer leak into the footer — that narrowing is the intended fix, and populated climate findings still qualify because they carry value + source.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Applies to every brief render from now on, including replays of already-stored runs, because the list is derived at render time from the received sections — no backfill needed.
pre_impl.external_source_error: A section that errored or returned not_available streams a DataField with value null; under the new gate its source simply stays off the footer instead of being advertised as a source that informed the brief.
pre_impl.frontend_type: collectSources moved to a pure module with an injected link-label formatter; page.tsx passes its existing formatKey so link labels render byte-identical, and DataSourcesCard's props/JSX are unchanged so styling is preserved.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: A reader comparing the footer against the cards no longer sees sources the run never used — the prior state overstated provenance, which is a trust defect on a product whose pitch is every-figure-traced-to-its-source.

functions.name: collectSources
functions.input: the streamed section events ({data:{data}} objects) plus an optional link-label formatter (page.tsx injects its formatKey)
functions.output: sorted per-run source rows {label, asAt} deduped case-insensitively on the normalised label with the latest as_at kept, plus the legislation/source URL links
functions.if_none: no populated fields yields empty sources; DataSourcesCard already returns null when both lists are empty, so the card disappears instead of rendering an empty shell

functions.name: humanizeSource
functions.input: an internal source slug string from a DataField's source key
functions.output: the mapped real-world label from SOURCE_LABELS, or a title-cased fallback for unknown slugs
functions.if_none: unknown slugs never drop — the fallback formatter always returns a printable label

functions.name: defaultLinkLabel
functions.input: a *_url key stem when no formatter is injected (tests / future callers)
functions.output: a title-cased label for the link pill
functions.if_none: the || 'Source' guard at the call site keeps an empty stem from rendering a blank link label

values.value: o.value on each walked object (the populated-field gate)
values.if_missing: an absent value key or a null/undefined value means the citing field did not populate — the source is skipped, which is the fix itself; false and 0 still count via the != null check
non-string as_at becomes undefined; the merge only overwrites an existing stamp when the incoming one is a string and lexicographically later, so a null stamp never erases a real date

values.value: existing srcMap entry for a repeated label key
values.if_missing: first sighting inserts the row; later sightings of the same lower-cased label only update the as-at, so two slugs for the same source can never produce two rows

break_it.scenario: A brief where the DCP pipeline did not run (council not onboarded) still advertises 'Plotdetect Dcp' in the footer
break_it.what_happens: Pre-change: the walker harvested the source slug off the null-valued DataField and listed it as a source that informed the brief
break_it.how: the gate requires a value key with a non-null value before a citation counts; a null-only source never reaches srcMap
break_it.repro: npx jest --testPathPatterns=brief-sources-per-run -t 'excludes a source cited only by null-valued fields'

break_it.scenario: Two internal slugs (live_protection_overlay, planning_portal_protection) map to the same label and render 'NSW Planning Portal — Protection layers' twice
break_it.what_happens: Pre-change: dedupe keyed on the raw slug, so the same real-world source appeared as duplicate rows
break_it.how: srcMap keys on the lower-cased normalised label; the second slug merges into the first row and only bumps the as-at if later
break_it.repro: npx jest --testPathPatterns=brief-sources-per-run -t 'collapses duplicate source labels to one entry, keeping the latest as-at'

break_it.scenario: The stricter gate over-prunes: a screening field whose real answer is false or 0 (e.g. an ANEF flag) loses its source from the footer
break_it.what_happens: A naive truthiness check would treat legitimate negative results as not-populated and hide sources the run genuinely used
break_it.how: the gate is o.value != null (loose inequality), so false and 0 count as populated; only null/undefined/absent are excluded
break_it.repro: npx jest --testPathPatterns=brief-sources-per-run -t 'a field with value false or 0 still counts as populated'

break_it.scenario: Non-DataField objects that happen to carry a source key (climate manifest sources_unavailable rows) sneak onto the footer as sources
break_it.what_happens: Pre-change: {source, reason} objects for datasets that were checked but had no coverage were listed as data sources of the brief
break_it.how: objects without a value key never qualify; the climate wrapper DataField still contributes its own source when populated
break_it.repro: npx jest --testPathPatterns=brief-sources-per-run -t 'an object carrying source but no value key is not a populated field'

break_it.scenario: Extracting the collector out of page.tsx changes link-label rendering because the module can no longer see formatKey and its override maps
break_it.what_happens: Link pills under the source list would silently change wording for keys with FIELD_LABEL_OVERRIDES entries
break_it.how: collectSources takes the formatter as a parameter and page.tsx injects the same formatKey it always used; the default formatter only serves tests
break_it.repro: npx jest --testPathPatterns=brief-sources-per-run -t 'still collects legislation/source URLs as links' plus tsc --noEmit on page.tsx

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes — re-open the live Kincumber brief (20 Patanga St) and check the footer: no 'Plotdetect Dcp', no 'Satellite imagery + structure detection', and 'NSW Planning Portal — Protection layers' appears once
